acquisition.method: Native bounded public official reads, raw SHA-256 capture, full PDF text extraction and rendered-page date/scope inspection

rules: All date findings are candidate-only; canonical null dates, status and freshness remain unchanged.
Closed means only the specific old 2026 intake application period is past; no whole programme discontinuation is claimed.
Relative, recurring or unmatched-year dates remain unknown. Old fee-reference data is not rolled into a new year.
Candidate opening dates are separate from canonical agreement; openingDateAssessed is false for every record.
Applicant submission and later institutional review/payment/qualification stages are distinct. Exact 09:00 and 17:00 cutoffs are preserved.
No application portal acceptance or whole-school completion was tested or claimed.
